checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Calm water, open sky, few elements.
Warm peach/gold sun breaking through clouds.
Soft pastel peach, lavender, blue harmonize with lighthouse and boat.

faults.what: Low resolution (640px wide), limits print use
Image is slightly sharper/more digital than true watercolor; the lighthouse is mildly tidy

summary: A calm, soft watercolor of a lighthouse and lone sailboat at dawn that meets the brief well, with only small resolution and polish limitations.
